doc.title: Danny Barker Interview (Louis Armstrong memorial broadcast), 1971-07-09

title: Armstrong's warmth with people, Europe, New Orleans pride and James Brown
summary: Barker recalls Armstrong greeting everyone, his dressing room, red beans and rice, his rolling with the punches, his acclaim in Europe like Bechet, Barker's return to New Orleans, the coming funeral at the armory, and the comparison with James Brown.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
